title: Time Jump: 20:30, One Deceased, Four Different Counts

fields.scenarioTitle: Open on Paper — Hospital Capacity Board & MCI Patient Flow
fields.narration: It is now 20:30 the same evening, one hour later. It is dark, the rain is easing and it is 42 degrees. The last trapped patient, tag LC-0425, was cut free at 19:58. MEDCOM confirmed by voice on MED 1, and the patient went to LRMC by ground. All groups gave a PAR at 20:05, and every member is accounted for. LC-0412, the patient upgraded to Immediate, left for St. Brendan's at 19:38 after the St. Brendan's supervisor confirmed by voice that they would take him. Air 7 lifted LC-0421, the head injury with a deficit, to Lakeshore at 20:24. The second transit bus came in from County Road K north and is loading the last four Minor patients. At 20:22 the Medical Director spoke with the Triage Leader by phone. The patient tagged Expectant, LC-0428, a man in his seventies, was reassessed and had no signs of life. His tag now reads Deceased. He is covered in place in the treatment area, and a paramedic is staying with him. LRMC went to Limited intake at 20:30 and will take Immediate patients only after a voice confirmation. Pinecrest is still on Diversion. The paper board on the MEDCOM whiteboard is the only hospital status everyone trusts. The scene is almost clear, but the hospitals, the transport log, the reunification center and Channel 9 News each have a different number.
worldState: Clock: 20:30. Dark, rain easing, 42°F.
Rescue: all seven trapped patients are out. LC-0425 was freed at 19:58 and went to LRMC by ground after a voice confirmation on MED 1.
Accountability: PAR from all groups at 20:05. All members accounted for. Firefighter Kowalczyk is in the LRMC ED and is not counted in the 28 patients.

Transport since 19:30: LC-0412 (Immediate, upgraded from Delayed) to St. Brendan's at 19:38 after a voice confirmation; LC-0425 (Immediate) to LRMC by ground; LC-0421 (Immediate, head injury with deficit) lifted to Lakeshore by Air 7 at 20:24.
Minor patients: the second Larkfield County Transit bus came in from County Road K north and is loading the last 4 Minor patients for the Brandt Lake High School minor injury site.

LC-0428: reassessed after the 20:22 phone call between the Medical Director and the Triage Leader. The tag changed from Expectant to Deceased. A man in his 70s, covered in place in the treatment area, with a paramedic staying with him.
Hazmat: the saddle tank was plugged at 19:15. About 40 gallons of diesel were released, diked and absorbed at the storm drain.
LRMC: Limited intake since 20:30 (Immediate by voice confirmation only). 2 stable inpatients moved to Lakeshore with the coalition.
Pinecrest Memorial: still on Diversion, holding 9 walk-ins who came by private car with no scene tags.
St. Brendan's: Limited intake, CT down, no head injuries.

Capacity board: the StatusGrid StatusSync service is still down. The tablets and the web board still show stale 16:55 statuses. The paper board on the MEDCOM whiteboard and the MED 1 voice roll call are the only status everyone trusts.
Dispatch: CAD shows 13 pending calls county-wide.
Public count: the JIC has not released a confirmed number. Channel 9 News is still saying '40 injured' and plans to air 'at least 40 casualties' at 21:00 unless it gets one confirmed number by 20:45.
fields.facilitatorNote: This is the first death of the exercise. Expect the IC to notify the Medical Examiner's office right away, leave LC-0428 where he is, and hold back the deceased count until the IC approves it and MEDCOM confirms it. Watch whether MED and MEDCOM keep the MED 1 voice roll call as the source of truth for destinations, and whether anyone reconciles the 28 tagged patients with the 9 untagged Pinecrest walk-ins and the reunification list.

instructorNote: Moves the clock to 20:30 and introduces the first Deceased tag. It tests ME notification, control of the body and the count, and whether MED 1 stays the source of truth for destinations. Watch for a deceased count being released before IC approval or MEDCOM reconciliation, and for anyone switching back to the board.
